boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Touro study environments across its New York City locations, with documented features or support services.

cards.entity_name: Touro University Library at 3 Times Square
cards.title: Work by the 43rd Street windows
cards.subtitle: Third floor, 3 Times Square · Manhattan
cards.notes: Use a library study spot between classes and bring materials for a focused session; the university’s campus tour notes views of 43rd Street.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor library with study spots and 43rd Street views.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s School of Health Sciences campus tour identifies the library on the third floor at Times Square and describes its study spots and views of 43rd Street.
cards.source_title: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) Program | School of Health Sciences | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Located at Touro’s Times Square campus; the source does not state public visitor access or room-reservation rules.

cards.title: Settle into the quiet corner
cards.subtitle: 227 West 60 Street · Manhattan
cards.notes: Plan a quiet reading or writing block in the campus library, then confirm the posted schedule with library staff before making a late visit.
cards.short_summary: Campus library specifically described as having a quiet corner for study.
cards.evidence_claim: Lander College for Women describes its campus library as a place with a quiet corner to study and publishes its regular hours.
cards.source_title: Library | Lander College for Women | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Published regular hours: Sun 12–5 p.m.; Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–10 p.m.; Fri 9 a.m.–2 p.m. Hours may extend during exams; confirm before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Women Student Lounge
cards.title: Bring a small-group agenda to the lounge
cards.subtitle: 227 West 60 Street · Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the student lounge for a collaborative session; arrive with a shared task list and keep your materials compact for a common-area setup.
cards.short_summary: A campus common area identified by Touro for study groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Lander College for Women identifies its lounge as a place used for study groups.
cards.source_title: Active students, vibrant campus. | Lander College for Women | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Student common area at Lander College for Women; the source does not publish visitor access, reservations, or hours.

cards.title: Make the cafeteria your discussion table
cards.subtitle: 227 West 60 Street · Manhattan
cards.notes: Choose this common-area setting for an active study group, and check campus guidance before relying on it for a long session or food service.
cards.short_summary: A campus cafeteria Touro identifies as a study-group setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Lander College for Women identifies its cafeteria as a place used for study groups.
cards.source_title: Active students, vibrant campus. | Lander College for Women | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Campus cafeteria at Lander College for Women; food service, visitor access, and hours are not stated on the cited page.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Women Sunlit Terrace
cards.title: Take reading outside on the terrace
cards.subtitle: 227 West 60 Street · Manhattan
cards.notes: When conditions allow, bring a portable reading assignment to the terrace; use the outdoor setting for a change of pace between indoor work blocks.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus terrace identified for studying with friends.
cards.evidence_claim: Lander College for Women states that students use its sunlit terrace to prepare for class and study with friends when the weather is warm.
cards.source_title: Active students, vibrant campus. | Lander College for Women | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor terrace at Lander College for Women; use is weather-dependent. The cited page does not publish hours or public-access terms.

cards.title: Use the glass-walled library
cards.subtitle: Kew Gardens Hills · Queens
cards.notes: Choose a library table for reading or research and take advantage of the above-ground setting; confirm campus access details directly before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A 7,000-square-foot campus library with a glass main wall.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s Lander College catalog describes the Lander College for Men campus as having a 7,000-square-foot library whose main wall is glass.
cards.source_title: Lander College of Arts and Sciences Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in the Lander College for Men academic center in Kew Gardens Hills. The catalog does not state visitor access, reservations, or current hours.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Men Beis Medrash/Study Hall
cards.title: Open your books in the Beis Medrash
cards.subtitle: Kew Gardens Hills · Queens
cards.notes: Use this named study hall for book-based work and keep the session focused; check the college for current access expectations before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A 4,500-square-foot named study hall in the academic center.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s Lander College catalog identifies a 4,500-square-foot Beis Medrash/Study Hall at Lander College for Men.
cards.source_title: Lander College of Arts and Sciences Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in the Lander College for Men academic center in Kew Gardens Hills. The catalog does not publish public-access terms or hours.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Men Student Lounge
cards.title: Use the lounge for a working break
cards.subtitle: Kew Gardens Hills · Queens
cards.notes: Set up a short, collaborative work block in the indoor student lounge, then move finished work to your own storage before leaving the space.
cards.short_summary: A named indoor student lounge in the academic center.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s Lander College catalog lists an indoor student lounge among the facilities at Lander College for Men.
cards.source_title: Lander College of Arts and Sciences Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located at Lander College for Men in Kew Gardens Hills. The cited catalog does not specify study use, visitor access, or hours.

cards.entity_name: NYSCAS Learning Resource Center at Neptune Avenue Campus
cards.title: Pair quiet work with learning support
cards.subtitle: Neptune Avenue campus · Brooklyn
cards.notes: Use the center’s quiet-study and computer resources around an academic-support appointment; Brooklyn in-person visits may be walk-in or by appointment.
cards.short_summary: A Brooklyn academic-support setting with quiet study spaces and computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: NYSCAS says its Learning Resource Centers provide quiet study spaces and computer access, and that in-person Brooklyn visits take place at the Neptune Avenue campus.
cards.source_title: Becker, Deborah, Goldstein, Inna | New York School of Career and Applied Studies | Touro University
cards.access_notes: For in-person Learning Resource Center visits, NYSCAS says Brooklyn can be walk-in or by appointment. Schedules vary by semester; consult the current Canvas booking information.

cards.entity_name: NYSCAS Learning Resource Center at Times Square Campus
cards.title: Book a supported study session in Times Square
cards.subtitle: Times Square campus · Manhattan
cards.notes: Reserve an in-person session when you want quiet study space alongside tutoring or writing support; NYSCAS directs Manhattan visitors to book first.
cards.short_summary: A Manhattan Learning Resource Center setting with quiet study and computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: NYSCAS says its Learning Resource Centers provide quiet study spaces and computer access, and that in-person Manhattan appointments take place at the Times Square campus.
cards.source_title: Becker, Deborah, Goldstein, Inna | New York School of Career and Applied Studies | Touro University
cards.access_notes: NYSCAS states that in-person Manhattan Learning Resource Center visits are by appointment only. Schedules vary by semester; book through the current Canvas information.
